_comment: DEV DECK - Requiem (Bard / Necromancer), 50 hand-authored dev cards (owner-designed, 2026-08-25). NON-CANON: every card carries dev:true so shipped-pool queries can exclude them. The THIRD dev deck - with it, all ten classes hold cards. Phase 1 = AUTHOR + FLAG (the Sworn Wild convention): cards whose behavior has a live engine path carry structured effects; every behavior the engine cannot yet honor carries an effectsFlag starting 'DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED' (visible machinery debt; the validator reports it and does not fail). That flag list IS the arc plan for the implementation sessions that follow. FOUR NEW KEYWORDS ratified into Master_Keyword_List.md 2026-08-25, all done:false in the registry: CRESCENDO (Bard - the Untamed shape, CONTROLLER-scoped: while you control a Vocal Construct your characters are in Crescendo; keyword-independent like Untamed), REPRISE (Bard - replaces the sacrifice from LAST-Anchor-counter removal, decay AND effect removal alike per the unified 2026-07-15 sacrifice family, with a return to hand; the construct leaves but never dies), HAUNT (Necromancer - reworked same day from 'Restless' after the first owner playtest: the death fully happens FIRST, then an owner-routed return to an empty slot, exhausted, WITH A MEMORY COUNTER - the counter IS the tracker, and a companion that dies carrying one stays dead; per-stint - counters cease on zone change so outside reanimation resets it; no slot = no return and no counter, Haunt retained; a FLEE counts - a flee is a death, 2026-07-20), ENTOMB N (Necromancer - self-mill N on entry; renamed from 'Exhume' before authoring - to entomb is to bury). BARD HAS INSPIRE ACCESS (owner-ruled 2026-08-25, access-list amendment only - definition unchanged). Initiative remains BANNED - Bard was designed without it, deliberately. NO FREESTANDING STAT-MODIFIER TEXT (owner ruling 2026-08-25): generic +X/+X auras and riders are not this game's design vocabulary; every printed bonus is keyword-tied (Untamed-style, e.g. Gilded Lute's Crescendo attack bonus) or a derived characteristic (Conductor's Dead-Zone census). Typing: reanimated animals print BOTH modifiers ('Undead Beast Bear', per the 2026-08-18 zombified-shrew canon, owner-confirmed 2026-08-25); incorporeal entities print Spirit; Liches print Undead (a lich is a corporeal reanimation of itself). Vocal subtypes: Chant and Song (Bard's canon pair; Rite/Blessing are Druid/Paladin's, Utterance/Dirge are DW's). Construct subtype field carries the single token (the Rite precedent); Vocal-ness derives from subtype membership {Chant, Song, Rite, Blessing, Utterance, Dirge} - cf. isPhysicalConstruct. WIN CONDITIONS by design: Conductor of the Unquiet (count-derived attack off the stocked Dead Zone) and Vielle (twice-per-turn attacks while any song holds). Keyword reminder text is copied VERBATIM from docs/Master_Keyword_List.md. ARC A (2026-08-25): MILL + ENTOMB + DECK-OUT landed. The mill op is interpreted (target:'self' = the controller's own deck, partial when short, never a loss); ENTOMB is live at both enter sites (inline runOnEnter for single-unit carriers, an 'entomb' enterUnit kind for the Arc G owner-ordered window - Palegrove Gravekeeper's Entomb+Scavenger ordering is the live probe); and the EMPTY-DECK LOSS is implemented at the drawCards chokepoint per the owner ruling 2026-08-25: ANY mandatory draw from an empty deck loses the game - the Draw Phase draw AND effect draws (canon GRU 'When deck is empty and player must draw, player loses'). Tomb Chanter and Grave Whispers are authored live against the op. ARC B (2026-08-25): CRESCENDO landed - inCrescendo (engine/stats.ts) is the isUntamedEncounter pattern CONTROLLER-scoped, derived on read, keyword-independent; Vocal-ness = isVocalConstruct over subtype {Chant, Song, Rite, Blessing, Utterance, Dirge}. Seven carriers live: Busker (conditional Ranged via the Arc C aura path), Satyr (the OWNER-RULED mid-combat target pick - pendingCombatPick pauses the declared attack on the stack, the forced-sacrifice discipline; onKill/onDealDamage keep the documented auto-pick, cf. Mason's Hammer), Skald (startOfTurn clause-if now honored via permanentEffects game-threading; his extra draw at an empty deck IS a mandatory draw and LOSES - the Arc A chokepoint), Siren (entry-snapshot via onEnterEffects + bounce.levelAtMost), Encore of the Dawn (additive-instead, clause-if gated at CAST via onPlayEffects), Standing Ovation (ready max/maxIf riding the destroyUpTo two-step as 'readyUpTo'; second pick optional, cancel commits), Gilded Lute (selfItemStat evaluates board-state ifs for the bearer's controller). ARC C (2026-08-25): HAUNT + MEMORY COUNTERS landed. memoryCounters is a GENERAL BoardEntity resource (owner flag 2026-08-25: future cards - possibly a Siblari ability - will place them on permanents and key non-Haunt effects off them; Haunt is their FIRST consumer, never their owner; absent-when-zero, visible as a card-face badge). The death check reads the PRE-removal entity at BOTH death sites (destroyEntity; the applyReadyRemovals flee exit - a flee haunts, self-balancing), the owed return rides pendingHauntQueue and arms only after the death's windows drain, and the return is a REAL ENTER: Marrowlight Lich re-Entombs on his own return (the pinned collision), opposing enter-traps hear it, Paranoia does not (a return is not a play). Full board = no return AND no counter (Haunt retained). Crown of the Unquiet King grants Haunt via ITEM_GRANTED_KEYWORDS - the returned body comes back BARE (items transferred at death) and the counter, not the item, is the tracker. Conductor's count-derived attack = buff.perOwnDeadCompanions, derive-on-read off the controller's Dead-Zone companion census. One dated exclusion: a decayed Manifest wearing the Crown does not haunt (no carrier scenario; see applyReadyRemovals).

cards.name: Gravegnaw Rat
cards.text: ENTOMB 1. When this enters the encounter, put the top card of your deck into your Dead Zone.

cards.name: Barrowlight Ghoul
cards.text: HAUNT. When this companion dies, if it had no Memory counters on it, return it from your Dead Zone to an empty Command Zone slot you control, exhausted, with a Memory counter on it.

cards.name: Palegrove Gravekeeper
cards.text: SCAVENGER. When this companion enters the encounter, you may return an item from your Dead Zone and immediately attach it to this companion. ENTOMB 2. When this enters the encounter, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your Dead Zone.

cards.name: Sallow Revenant
cards.text: HAUNT. When this companion dies, if it had no Memory counters on it, return it from your Dead Zone to an empty Command Zone slot you control, exhausted, with a Memory counter on it.

cards.name: Gravemarsh Hyena
cards.text: SCAVENGER. When this companion enters the encounter, you may return an item from your Dead Zone and immediately attach it to this companion.

cards.name: Duskveil Wraith
cards.text: When this companion dies, you may return another companion card from your Dead Zone to your hand.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): onDeath + returnFromDead(to hand) both exist, but the op cannot exclude the event subject — the Wraith itself is in the Dead Zone when the trigger resolves and 'another' must bar it from the pick.

cards.name: Tomb Chanter
cards.text: At the start of your turn, put the top card of your deck into your Dead Zone.

cards.name: Gravemarsh Reanimator
cards.text: When this companion enters the encounter, you may return a companion card with level 3 or less from your Dead Zone to an empty Command Zone slot you control. It enters exhausted.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): returnFromDead to:'encounter' is unimplemented (interpreter is hand-only), and the op has no level-cap filter and no enters-exhausted rider. NOTE for the arc: a Dead-Zone return to the encounter is an ENTER — enter triggers re-fire (a returned Coercion or Entomb carrier triggers again).

cards.name: Marrowlight Lich
cards.text: HAUNT. When this companion dies, if it had no Memory counters on it, return it from your Dead Zone to an empty Command Zone slot you control, exhausted, with a Memory counter on it. ENTOMB 2. When this enters the encounter, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your Dead Zone.

cards.name: Conductor of the Unquiet
cards.text: HAUNT. When this companion dies, if it had no Memory counters on it, return it from your Dead Zone to an empty Command Zone slot you control, exhausted, with a Memory counter on it. This companion gets +1 attack for each companion card in your Dead Zone.

cards.name: Emberlight Busker
cards.text: CRESCENDO — While in Crescendo, this companion has Ranged.

cards.name: Silverstring Harper
cards.text: INSPIRE. As long as one or more permanents with Inspire are in the encounter under your control, you are Inspired.

cards.name: Satyr of the Reel
cards.text: When this companion attacks while in Crescendo, add an Anchor counter to target Vocal Construct you control.

cards.name: Glimmerwood Teller
cards.text: When this companion enters the encounter, draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): the discard op models only opponent-victim scopes (targetPlayer/damagedController/eventSubject) — an OWN-choice discard by the controller has no scope and no prompt path.

cards.name: Skald of the Long Dusk
cards.text: At the start of your turn, if you are in Crescendo, draw an additional card.

cards.name: Duskmere Siren
cards.text: INSPIRE. As long as one or more permanents with Inspire are in the encounter under your control, you are Inspired. When this companion enters the encounter, if you are in Crescendo, return target opposing companion with level 3 or less to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Vielle, Voice of the Requiem
cards.text: INSPIRE. As long as one or more permanents with Inspire are in the encounter under your control, you are Inspired. While in Crescendo, this companion may attack twice each turn.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): Crescendo condition plus a standing TWICE-PER-TURN attack allowance (extraAttack is a one-shot op; a continuous 'may attack twice while <state>' eligibility does not exist). This is the deck's Bard win condition.

cards.name: Song of Hearthlight
cards.text: Other Vocal Constructs you control enter the encounter with an additional Anchor counter.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): entry-state modification — nothing today alters the Anchor count a construct enters with (parseAnchor reads the printed value only).

cards.name: Chant of Returning
cards.text: REPRISE. When this Vocal Construct would be sacrificed because its last Anchor counter was removed, return it to your hand instead. When this construct enters the encounter, look at the top two cards of your deck. Put any number of them on the bottom of your deck and the rest back on top.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): REPRISE keyword — no replacement hook exists at either last-Anchor-counter site (readyPhase decay / anchor-removal ops; registry Reprise done:false). The onEnter peek IS live — with Reprise it becomes a recurring engine.

cards.name: Lullaby of the Deep Meadow
cards.text: REPRISE. When this Vocal Construct would be sacrificed because its last Anchor counter was removed, return it to your hand instead. When this construct enters the encounter, exhaust target opposing companion.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): REPRISE keyword — see Chant of Returning. The onEnter exhaust IS live. DELIBERATE: Reprise makes the exhaust repeatable at a replay cost each loop — the closest card in the deck to Bard's no-long-term-lockdown line, owner-accepted 2026-08-25.

cards.name: Anthem of the Unbroken
cards.text: Other Vocal Constructs you control do not lose an Anchor counter at the start of your turn.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): Vocal variant of preventAnchorDecay (the live op is own-Physical-Constructs only and has no 'other' exclusion — the Anthem itself must still decay).

cards.name: Discordant Air
cards.text: When this construct enters the encounter, target opposing companion attacks another target opposing companion.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): forceAttack exists but supports only a NON-interactive attackers spec with one interactive target (Press the Line) — this needs an interactive attacker pick AND attacker-distinct-from-target. Charm routed through a Vocal Construct per canon; probes forced-attacks-are-attacks + Guardian binding from a charm source.

cards.name: Chorale of the Twilight Host
cards.text: Companions you control have Ranged.

cards.name: Ossuary Altar
cards.text: When a companion you control dies, put the top card of your deck into your Dead Zone.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): needs an own-companion-death listener (no trigger hears an OWN companion dying; ownPhysicalConstructSacrificed is the nearest relative) plus the uninterpreted mill op. COLLISION: fires alongside a Haunt return off the same death — same-owner ordering.

cards.name: Soulmarsh Prison
cards.text: Remove an Anchor counter from this construct: Return target companion card from your Dead Zone to your hand.

cards.name: Field of the Unquiet
cards.text: Opposing companions enter the encounter exhausted.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): entry-state modification for OPPOSING entries — nothing today alters the state a companion enters with. Collides with Zealous (the willpower check is waived but an exhausted companion still cannot attack) and blanks ready-dependent states (an exhausted Guardian does not taunt).

cards.name: Grave Whispers
cards.text: Put the top two cards of your deck into your Dead Zone. Draw a card.

cards.name: Raise the Marrow
cards.text: Return target companion card with level 1 or less from your Dead Zone to an empty Command Zone slot you control. It enters exhausted.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): returnFromDead to:'encounter' unimplemented + no level-cap filter + no enters-exhausted rider (the reanimation family — see Gravemarsh Reanimator).

cards.name: Gravedigger's Due
cards.text: Return target item card from your Dead Zone to your hand.

cards.name: Feast for Worms
cards.text: Sacrifice a companion. If you do, draw two cards.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): the sacrifice op is implemented for target:'self' only — an OWN-companion sacrifice pick (chooser = controller, PC never offered) has no path, and the draw is conditional on the sacrifice actually happening.

cards.name: Lay to Rest
cards.text: Destroy target companion with level 2 or less.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): destroy is live but has no level-cap target filter (bounce.hpAtMost is the only stat-capped filter in the vocabulary).

cards.name: Echoes of the Departed
cards.text: Return target companion card from your Dead Zone to an empty Command Zone slot you control. It enters exhausted.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): returnFromDead to:'encounter' unimplemented + no enters-exhausted rider (the reanimation family).

cards.name: Toll the Silence
cards.text: Destroy target companion whose level is less than the number of companion cards in your Dead Zone.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): destroy is live but the target-legality condition is a DEAD-ZONE CENSUS (count companion cards in your Dead Zone) — no count-derived target filter exists. Mill-payoff removal.

cards.name: The Great Unrest
cards.text: Return up to three companion cards with level 2 or less from your Dead Zone to empty Command Zone slots you control. They enter exhausted.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): the reanimation family at multi-scale: to:'encounter' + level cap + exhausted rider + 'up to three' multi-pick (castable at one eligible target per the pre-cost refusal precedent, dd000096 ruling). A multi-return opens a multi-pending enter window (Arc G machinery) from the Dead Zone side.

cards.name: Requiem of the Hollow Bell
cards.text: Destroy target companion. You may return a companion card with level equal to or less than that companion's level from your Dead Zone to an empty Command Zone slot you control. It enters exhausted.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): destroy is live but the return is LEVEL-COUPLED to the destroyed target (a value read off the first effect's target feeding the second's filter) on top of the whole reanimation family.

cards.name: Turn of Phrase
cards.text: Draw a card. Then put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): no op moves a chosen card from HAND to the bottom of the deck (deckPeek moves deck cards; discard moves hand cards to the Dead Zone).

cards.name: Encore of the Dawn
cards.text: Draw a card. If you are in Crescendo, draw two cards instead.

cards.name: Standing Ovation
cards.text: Ready target companion you control. If you are in Crescendo, ready up to two target companions you control instead.

cards.name: Steal the Show
cards.text: Target opponent reveals their hand. Choose a non-Companion card from it; that player puts it on the bottom of their deck, then draws a card.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): revealHand pick:'toBottomDraw' is live (Mark the Pockets) but has NO card-type filter — 'non-Companion' needs a filter param on the pick. Authoring the unfiltered op would contradict the printed text, so the card waits.

cards.name: Chorus Bell
cards.text: When you play a Vocal Construct, draw a card.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): needs an own-play window for CONSTRUCTS (ownPlaysCompanion and ownPlaysMagicalConstruct exist; a Vocal-Construct play window does not — plays and enters are canonically distinct, so the enter window is not a substitute).

cards.name: Gilded Lute
cards.text: Equipped companion gets +1 attack while you are in Crescendo.

cards.name: Gravecharm Locket
cards.text: When the equipped companion dies, draw two cards.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV NOT-IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-25): needs an item-hosted EQUIPPED-DIES window (onEquippedAttacked's family extended to the bearer's death) — and the Locket itself is bound for the Dead Zone off the same death unless transferred, so the trigger must outlive its source (2026-07-12 stack rule).

cards.name: Crown of the Unquiet King
cards.text: Equipped companion has Haunt.
cards.effectsFlag: DEV reminder-only (2026-08-25): the grant is carried by the printed keyword via ITEM_GRANTED_KEYWORDS (Haunt whitelisted, Arc C) — no structured effects exist to author. The death-time check reads the bearer's effectiveKeywords while the Crown is still equipped; the Memory counter, not the item, does all once-tracking (the returned body comes back bare).
